source:
Meta-ranking of published 'smartest animals' lists (fetched 2026-11-09). No single scientific intelligence score exists; this combines editorial rankings the way a meta-ranking does.

EDITORIAL 'SMARTEST' LISTS USED (16):
  [SF] BBC Science Focus - "Top 10 smartest animals in the world" (2023-07-13), 10 entries, ranked: numbered 1-10 (article hedges that scientists don't formally rank species); Humans listed #10. https://www.sciencefocus.com/nature/smartest-animals
  [LS] Live Science - "32 of the world's smartest animals" (2024-09-25), 32 entries, appearance: unnumbered; order of appearance (tagged 'Countdowns'); Humans listed last (#32). https://www.livescience.com/animals/32-of-the-smartest-animals-in-the-world
  [MF] Mental Floss - "Top 5 Smartest Animals in the World, Ranked by Intelligence" (2026-01-29), 9 entries, ranked: ranked 1-5; four 'honorable mentions' appended as positions 6-9 in order of mention. https://www.mentalfloss.com/animals/smartest-animals-in-the-world
  [AZ] A-Z Animals - "The 10 Smartest Animals in the World - Updated 2024 Rankings" (2024-06-01 (updated 2025-06-03)), 13 entries, ranked: countdown 10->1 (Orangutan #1); three 'honorable mentions' appended as positions 11-13. https://a-z-animals.com/blog/the-10-smartest-animals-in-the-world/
  [DW] BBC Wildlife / Discover Wildlife - "10 smartest animals on the planet" (2025-11-24), 10 entries, appearance: unnumbered; order of appearance. https://www.discoverwildlife.com/animal-facts/smartest-animals
  [BI] Business Insider India - "The Smartest Animals On The Planet" (undated (c. 2014)), 9 entries, appearance: unnumbered; order of appearance; article says it offers no definitive ranking. https://www.businessinsider.in/the-smartest-animals-on-the-planet/articleshow/34125571.cms
  [RD] Reader's Digest Australia - "15 animals that are probably smarter than you" (modified 2024-01-09), 14 entries, appearance: unnumbered; order of appearance; 14 entries found on page. https://www.readersdigest.com.au/news-articles/15-animals-that-are-probably-smarter-than-you
  [AFF] Animal Fun Facts (tierchenwelt) - "Top 16 Most Intelligent Animals in the World" (updated 2026-04-22), 16 entries, ranked: numbered 1-16 ('Top 16'); page does not state ranking criteria. https://www.animalfunfacts.net/knowledge/top-lists/326-smartest-animals-in-the-world.html
  [CW] The Cold Wire - "Top 20 Smartest Animals In The World" (undated), 20 entries, ranked: explicitly ranked 1-20. https://www.thecoldwire.com/smartest-animals-in-the-world/
  [TR] TRVST - "Top 12 Smartest Animals In The World That Will Impress You" (2024-05-08 (updated 2024-12-08)), 12 entries, ranked: numbered 1-12 ('Top 12'); no stated criteria. https://www.trvst.world/biodiversity/smartest-animals/
  [WN] Wildlife Nomads - "Top 12 Smartest Animals in the World (You'll Be Surprised!)" (2025-05-31 (updated 2026-11-08)), 12 entries, ranked: numbered 1-12; entry 6 'Great Apes' covers gorillas, orangutans, bonobos and (as a subsection) chimpanzees. https://www.wildlifenomads.com/blog/top-smartest-intelligent-animals
  [ST] Science Times - "10 Smartest Animals on Earth: Incredible Intelligence, Tool Use, and Problem-Solving Skills" (2026-01-09), 10 entries, ranked: explicitly ranked 01-10. https://www.sciencetimes.com/articles/61105/20260109/10-smartest-animals-earth-incredible-intelligence-tool-use-problem-solving-skills.htm
  [BP] Bored Panda - "These Are Some Of The Smartest Animals Ever Studied, According To Science" (2025-11-19), 17 entries, ranked: numbered 1-17; order reflects reader up-votes (points 8 down to 2). https://www.boredpanda.com/smartest-animals/
  [PS] Popular Science - "What are the smartest animals in the world, and how do we know?" (2018-03-30), 7 entries, appearance: unnumbered; order of appearance. https://www.popsci.com/worlds-smartest-animals/
  [DM] Discover Magazine - "5 of the World's Most Intelligent Animals" (2022-03-04), 5 entries, appearance: unnumbered; order of appearance. https://www.discovermagazine.com/planet-earth/5-of-the-worlds-most-intelligent-animals
  [AF] Africa Freak - "Top 25 smartest animals in the world" (2022-07-15 (updated 2024-07-04)), 25 entries, ranked: explicitly ranked (T-1 tie: Chimpanzee & Bonobo; no #2). https://africafreak.com/smartest-animals

'LEAST INTELLIGENT' LISTS (tail only):
  [RP] Ranger Planet - "11 Most Dumbest Animals on the Planet, and Why!" (2022-01-05 (updated 2022-01-31)), ranked: explicit countdown 11->1, #1 = dumbest (Sloth). https://rangerplanet.com/dumbest-animals-on-the-planet
  [AZD] A-Z Animals - "The 13 Least Intelligent Animals in the World (2025 Edition)" (2024-06-10 (updated 2025-06-02)), unordered: numbered but stated to be 'in no particular order' (membership only). https://a-z-animals.com/animals/lists/dumbest-animals/
  [BR] Briefly News - "Top 11 dumbest animals in the world: a surprising list with facts and pictures" (undated), numbered: numbered 1-11 but not stated to be a ranking (membership only). https://briefly.co.za/facts-lifehacks/top/189763-top-dumbest-animals-world-a-surprising-list-facts-pictures
  [AZM] A-Z Animals - "Dumbest Mammals" (2022-09-20), unordered: unnumbered collection (membership only). https://a-z-animals.com/blog/dumbest-mammals/

NEURON-COUNT PROXY (tail only): [WP] Wikipedia - "List of animals by number of neurons" (fetched 2026-11-09): whole-brain / whole-nervous-system neuron counts (Table 2); used ONLY to order animals that no editorial list covers. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_animals_by_number_of_neurons

METHOD: For every editorial list, each animal's placement is normalized to 0..1 as (rank-1)/(len-1) (0 = top of that list; 'ranked' lists use the source's numbering, 'appearance' lists use order of appearance on the page). Combined headings (e.g. 'Crows and ravens') give the same placement to each named animal; 'honorable mentions' are appended after the ranked entries in order of mention. Species are mapped to a common display name (bottlenose dolphin -> Dolphin; African/Asian elephant -> Elephant; sperm/humpback whale -> Whale; Border collie -> Dog; monitor lizards -> Komodo dragon; bumblebee/honeybee -> Honey bee; parrots -> African grey parrot; 'Cat (lions)' -> Cat; 'Monkey (baboons & mandrills)' -> Baboon; Long Evans rat -> Rat; jumping spider -> Portia spider). Crow and Raven are kept separate because several sources list them separately. Ordering, smartest first: (1) CONSENSUS rows = animals in >=3 editorial lists, by mean normalized rank (plain average across the lists that include the animal); (2) LOW-COVERAGE (2 lists) and SINGLE-SOURCE (1 list) rows, ordered together by their mean normalized rank - the >=3 threshold is standard meta-ranking practice and stops e.g. the Komodo dragon landing in the top 10 on two order-of-appearance placements; these rows are the least reliable (last place on a short top-10 list normalizes to 1.0); (3) NEURONS rows = familiar mammals/birds on no editorial list, by whole-brain neuron count; (4) DUMBEST-LIST rows = warm-blooded animals that appear only on 'least intelligent' lists, ordered by how many such lists include them, then Ranger Planet's explicit rank; (5) NEURONS rows for cold-blooded animals and invertebrates, by whole-brain neuron count, ending with the sea sponge (0 neurons). count = N - position + 1.

HUMANS: excluded. 2 of 16 lists include humans, but only as a closing wink (Science Focus #10 of 10, Live Science #32 of 32), so a meta-rank for Human would be meaningless.

CONSULTED BUT EXCLUDED: World Atlas '10 of the World's Smartest Animals' (numbered 10->1 but states 'in no particular order'); Tempo.co and 24/7 Tempo (alphabetical lists); RankRed (states 'not in any order'); TheTopTens (user-vote popularity list, Human #1); Science Blog 'Animal IQ Rankings' (unreviewed, duplicate species entries); Sparcus and Dotsure (verbatim copies of the A-Z Animals ranking); Natural Habitat Adventures top 25 and AOL (lists only in embedded video); Britannica (essay, no ranking); HowStuffWorks 'Top 30 Smartest Animals' (page blocked fetching); Fact Animal dumbest list (joke entries). Goldfish does not appear in any fetched source (Guppy stands in as the small aquarium fish). | Pruned for the quiz: obscure single-source species removed (Portia spider, Heliconius butterfly, fruit fly, poison dart frog, cleaner wrasse, jerboa, lemming, kakapo, slow loris, tardigrade, Goffin's cockatoo, scrub jay).
